dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based, uses MCP framework with MCPAREA/LINKAGE SECTION pattern typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – patient registration duplicate-check screen (二重登録疑い一覧画面 P02A)
purpose.summary: This program implements the duplicate patient registration check list screen (P02A) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It searches the patient information table (tbl_ptinf) for potential duplicate registrations based on kana name, sex, and birthdate criteria, then populates a screen area with matching candidates for operator review. It handles initial display, screen transitions, and confirmation dialog flows.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (28 copybooks) for screen and SPA areas
MCP framework calls (DBSELECT, PUTG/CLICKED event handling) – ORCA-specific middleware
CALL to ORCSDAY (date conversion), ORCSPTID (patient ID conversion), ORCSADDSIGN (search string normalization)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA – subprogram called by MCP runtime
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen control
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCP DB abstraction
verdict.notes: Source contains Japanese text comments encoded in a multibyte encoding (likely EUC-JP) decoded as Latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. File is truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient structure is visible. Program is a subprogram called by the ORCA MCP runtime, not a standalone batch program; classified as online-cics by analogy since it is event-driven screen-handling code within the ORCA GUI framework.
